ProductionPolicy: BackgroundPlatformBatch; CurrentBundled; PF5-R6 body sharing enabled; singleton compression disabled; Immediate/Near/Far 1/2/4; CrossLane cap 2; Game manifest v29; transport revision 2
ProcessTopologyQualification: In-process secure-UDP architecture harness. Server-owned phase clocks exclude the measured client receive/apply slices, but process CPU/RSS include both sides and must not be compared directly with the sharded V2 server process.
WholeServerQualification: R200/R350 whole-server rows compose the real current Game authority with the current secure-UDP ChunkPublication path in one same-tick harness. The product admission cap remains 64: these are benchmark-capacity participants, not admitted product CCU. Game movement drives the accepted input/locomotion/physics path while a deterministic public-world mirror supplies the replication fixture; actor positions are not handed directly between those two bounded fixtures. Chat timing uses the real GameChatService authority path but does not include remote Chat encoding/delivery in this composed benchmark.
TopologyDefinition: Topology groups use ordinary production AOI and are separated by 192 metres. Each group stores at most 20 public records per 16 m publication chunk. A group is a spatial region/chunk-group, not necessarily one physical chunk.
ControlledFanoutQualification: The controlled-fanout R64 rows use the same production AOI radius and approximately matched total memberships while varying 1/8/64 source groups. The dense row mutates once per six ticks so its dirty recipient-publication references remain near the medium/sparse rows; this deliberately varies distinct source bodies and source records and is not a fixed-authoritative-activity capacity comparison. Ordinary chunk-edge rounding is retained and every work count is reported.
InstrumentationQualification: Rated rows run with detailed Game attribution off. Each row has a separate short diagnostic census using identical semantic work; only its topology/body counters are copied into the rated row.
ArchivedSparseFixtureDisposition: No archived sparse V2 fixture was found. The V2-shaped sparse rows are explicit current-V3 reconstructions and are not historical V2 measurements.

HistoricalV2Dense.Interpretation: Separate server plus four client-worker processes; one session-owned movement entity per accepted client and no separately evidenced ambient population; dense 1 m spawn grid (width 20); 35% active; 20 Hz phased input with held movement applied by the 62 Hz server; AOI 7.5/23.5/39.5 m; ring cadence 1/2/3; movement, visual, bulk-every-16-ticks, and ordered-event-every-8-ticks families; latest-state recipient phasing cadence 2; latest-state batching disabled; Chat disabled; asynchronous server flush enabled. Main server tick and previous async send are separate distributions and are not added.
